![Customer retention rate + formula: A guide for 2026](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-fff5521d1ead:4)
A **retention rate** is `the percentage of people, customers, or employees who stay with a group or business over a specific period of time`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retention_rate)[[2]](https://www.paychex.com/articles/human-resources/what-is-employee-retention)

### Common Retention Formulas

### Customer Retention Rate (CRR)

Measures the percentage of customers a business keeps over a set timeframe. New customers acquired during the period are excluded from the starting total.[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/retention/calculate-customer-retention-rate/)[[2]](https://productive.io/blog/customer-retention-rate/)

- **Formula:** `[(End Period Customers - New Customers) ÷ Start Period Customers] × 100` 
- **Example:** If you start with 100 customers, add 20 new ones, and finish with 110 customers: `[(110 - 20) ÷ 100] × 100 = 90%`.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/service/digital-customer-engagement-platform/customer-retention-rate/)[[2]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/retention/calculate-customer-retention-rate/)[[3]](https://productive.io/blog/customer-retention-rate/)

### Employee Retention Rate

Measures the percentage of workers who remain employed by a company over a given timeframe (such as a quarter or a year).[[1]](https://www.paychex.com/articles/human-resources/what-is-employee-retention)

- **Formula:** `(Employees at end or retained ÷ Starting workforce headcount) × 100` 
- **Example:** If you start with 200 employees and 20 leave: `[(200 - 20) ÷ 200] × 100 = 90%`.[[1]](https://www.adp.com/resources/articles-and-insights/articles/r/retention-rate.aspx)[[2]](https://www.personio.com/hr-lexicon/increasing-employee-retention-rates/)[[3]](https://www.paychex.com/articles/human-resources/what-is-employee-retention)

### Student / First-Year College Retention Rate
Measures the proportion of full-time, first-time bachelor-seeking students who return to campus for their sophomore year.[[1]](https://www.businessinsider.com/college-highest-first-year-retention-rate-every-state-2026-9)

- **National Average:** Approximately 79.4% at four-year public universities.[[1]](https://www.inquirer.com/education/colleges-universities-philadelphia-retention-rates-dropouts-20261005.html)


---

### General Benchmarks

- **Employee Retention:** A rate **above 90%** is considered excellent, **85%–90%** is healthy, and **below 80%** often signals underlying management or cultural issues.
- **Customer Retention:** Varies widely by industry; media and professional services hover around **84%** , while subscription-based SaaS businesses often face higher churn.[[1]](https://productive.io/blog/customer-retention-rate/)[[2]](https://www.paychex.com/articles/human-resources/what-is-employee-retention)
